draft.emotion: hesitating at a price tag, thoughtful and a little concerned
notes: Meaning depends on position: before a noun it means 'dear' (mon cher ami), after a noun or verb it means 'expensive' (un livre cher).
Also used as an adverb with verbs like coûter or payer: Ça coûte cher (It costs a lot).
